answer: Because the wander weight is recomputed from the thread history each close, the pulse audit shows the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. Running a farm therefore buys partial influence at full price for every alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. A new identity spends its first 7 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 26% of full weight. That is 36 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
